profile.headline: Software Engineer at Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc.
profile.summary: Experienced Electronic Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the management consulting industry. Skilled in Rockwell/Studio 5000, Microsoft Word, FactoryTalk ME. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Northeastern University.
